title: Voice Assistant Provider Evaluation and Operational Review

liveProviderGate.requirement: Enterprise privacy agreement with 0-day data retention, zero training on customer audio/prompts, and commercial spending caps
liveProviderGate.currentTreatment: Live transmission gated; truthful unavailable message displayed; inputs disabled when gated; local mock adapter verified for offline validation

physicalDeviceGate.requirement: Physical ARM64 device testing with real microphone hardware and spoken TalkBack audio screen-reader ear listen-through
physicalDeviceGate.currentTreatment: Automated emulator and browser MediaRecorder tests executed; physical phone verification separated and recorded as blocked

evaluatedAdapters.modality: Direct audio buffer ingestion (base64) -> structured JSON transcription

languageCapabilities.bangla: Native Bengali script (Unicode U+0980..U+09FF) with full vowel matra and conjunct preservation
languageCapabilities.banglish: Code-switched Bengali-English recognized accurately without phonetic degradation

retentionGuarantees.databaseBinaryStorage: None. Only text transcript and metadata stored in app.ai_transcriptions

evaluatedAdapters.evaluationVerdict: Selected as primary live candidate due to 5x cost advantage over Whisper and native Bengali script fidelity; remains fail-closed under DEF-V2-008.

evaluatedAdapters.modality: Multipart audio file upload -> text transcript

languageCapabilities.bangla: Moderate; occasional transliteration errors on complex conjuncts

retentionGuarantees.policy: Requires enterprise BAA / zero-data retention endpoint configuration

evaluatedAdapters.evaluationVerdict: Secondary candidate; 500% higher unit cost than Gemini 1.5 Flash with lower Bangla conjunct fidelity; remains fail-closed.

languageCapabilities.english: Deterministic synthetic text fixtures and embedded MOCK_TRANSCRIPT: tags

uncertaintySimulation.silence: Zero bytes or 'silence' tag -> empty transcript, 0.0 confidence, uncertainSpeech: true

evaluatedAdapters.evaluationVerdict: Verified for local zero-cost integration testing, CI validation, and reproducible review workflows.

consentDecoupling.rule: Hardware microphone permission operates independently from external AI transmission consent
consentDecoupling.enforcement: Calling /v1/ai/assistant/transcribe strictly requires app.ai_consents.enabled = true, returning 403 AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED when disabled

retentionPolicy.enforcement: Server zeroes decoded Buffer in finally block; app.ai_transcriptions database schema has zero binary/base64 columns

noRawAudioInLogs.rule: Raw recording binaries or base64 streams must never appear in application logs or exception traces
noRawAudioInLogs.enforcement: Pino logger redaction and explicit exclusion of audioBase64 from log serializers

idempotentRetry.rule: Interrupted uploads re-sent with stable clientOperationId do not duplicate records or double-charge budget
idempotentRetry.enforcement: PostgreSQL partial unique index idx_ai_transcriptions_client_op on (user_id, workspace_id, client_operation_id)

zeroUnreviewedWrites.rule: Voice transcription alone never creates organizer records; reviewed transcripts must follow proposal review and explicit Save/Confirm
zeroUnreviewedWrites.enforcement: Confirmed proposals issue single-use confirmation tokens and write durable receipts in app.mutation_receipts under AI_DEVICE_ID
